findings.statement: The buyer asked specifically about box condition before purchase and the seller gave an unqualified assurance, so box condition was a bargained-for term, not incidental.
The listing itself described the sets as 'Used - like new. Boxes in good condition.' at a price of 200 for four sets.

The buyer's photo of the inner LEGO 21034 box shows visible damage to the upper-left corner region — creasing and a disturbed/opened corner — which is inconsistent with 'good condition' for a collector-grade retired set.
The outer shipping carton, on the two faces visible, appears square and undamaged, with intact tape and a FRAGILE marking; nothing in that image indicates a crushing impact in transit.
Tracking shows an ordinary transit and delivery on 28 August 2026 with no exception or damage event recorded, and the buyer reported the damage the same day.
The dispute was raised essentially immediately on redemption, so there is no delay that would weaken the buyer's account.
Only one of four boxes is complained of; the buyer retains all four sets and has not alleged missing or damaged contents.

provisional.reasoning: Box condition was expressly promised and one of four boxes arrived with a crushed, split corner, while the outer carton looks undamaged on the faces shown. The buyer keeps all four complete sets, so the loss is the diminished collector value of one box out of four, which a refund of about 30% of the price reflects.

requests.what: Photographs of the remaining two faces and all four bottom/top corners of the brown shipping carton shown in pho-1, ideally alongside the damaged LEGO box, plus a close-up of the damaged corner itself showing how far the split extends.
requests.whyItMatters: The one carton photo in the file shows only two sides, so it cannot show whether the outer packaging took an impact at the point matching the damaged corner. Views of the other faces, and a clear view of the extent of the damage, would settle both how the damage arose and how much of the box's value is affected.

wouldChange.answer: Outer carton is undamaged on all faces and the inner box corner is badly crushed and split open
wouldChange.implies: Damage was pre-existing or caused by insufficient internal protection; the assurance in msg-2 was inaccurate and the loss falls on the seller

wouldChange.answer: Outer carton shows a matching crush or puncture at the corresponding corner
wouldChange.implies: Transit impact despite a FRAGILE-marked carton; the item still arrived not as described but the seller's account of careful packing is corroborated, so the loss is shared

wouldChange.answer: Close-up shows only light shelf-wear or a minor crease rather than a split corner
wouldChange.implies: Deviation from 'good condition' is modest and the value impact small

requests.what: Any photographs of the four boxes taken before or during packing, and a description of how the sets were protected inside the brown carton (padding, wrapping, spacing).
requests.whyItMatters: The buyer's photo shows the box as it looked after arrival only. Evidence of the boxes' condition at the point of dispatch, and of how they were cushioned, is the only thing that can speak to the state they left you in.

wouldChange.answer: Dated pre-shipment photos showing that corner undamaged, with substantial padding described
wouldChange.implies: Condition on dispatch matched the listing and the damage arose after handover

wouldChange.answer: No pre-shipment photos, or photos showing the sets packed with little or no cushioning
wouldChange.implies: The assurance in msg-2 is unsupported and inadequate packing is attributable to the seller
